question: Do official Korean government press-release list queries expose identifiable October1-20 KCS original-release pages for 2018,2019,2020, complementing already NAS-backed 2021/2022 official October examples?
identity_gate: Each response HTTP200 official korea.kr list HTML for its frozen date range. Preserve exact bytes, headers, UTC time and SHA-256; NAS archive/remote hash/scoped restore. Parse only returned pressReleaseView links with title, displayed date and agency; accept October 1-20 KCS source lead only when title/date/agency match. If zero or ambiguous, report unknown, not source absence. Do not follow article/attachment links in this card.
timing_boundary: List query and a current archived title do not prove exact original attachment bytes, release second or first availability. A later exact-source card must separately freeze article/attachment URLs and check semantics before any factor.
stop: No retries, pagination changes or alternate search terms after result. An index lead is source-only, not a complete 2018-2022 monthly training panel or Stage1 0bp economic result.
